text:
zoe: Heads up 5m — noticed the console shows 0 collected samples for /api/chat on a tenant that definitely had sample decisions at edge.
ben: Are we seeing the same pattern as last month where router short-circuits on inspect_quota and drops the body?
marta: yep. edge sets X-RDW-SAMPLED and emits sample_id, router sometimes returns 202 and doesn't forward payload. collector only increments when it gets body so console shows 0.
zoe: That makes oncall confusing. From legal/audit POV a decision happened but no proof in console.
frank: quick idea: always forward a tiny "envelope" when sample_decision=true. Envelope contains sample_id, route, tenant_id, redaction_version, consent_state, and a signed token. No PII.
ben: love that. metric-wise we should add sample_envelope_forwarded and sample_envelope_dropped with labels {tenant, route, reason}. ops playbook can alert on drops.
audit-bot: playbook hint: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/sample-envelopes - recommend sample_envelope_forwarded metric.
marta: implementation: router will forward envelope even if payload is dropped. collector will accept envelope without needing KMS. Redaction still runs at collector for full payloads.
zoe: UX: console shows three small counters next to route: decisions | envelopes | payloads. Amber badge when envelopes > payloads. Hover text explains envelope is non-PII proof.
frank: edge-case: legal may require scrubbed payloads for investigations. envelope won't satisfy that. We'll need a secure-forward path where edge can redact and forward scrubbed payload even if quota denies full body. That's heavier.
ben: secure-forward implies edge needs ephemeral redact keys or KMS access. Can we avoid that initially and use envelope+admin_toggle for short term?
marta: yes. short-term: envelope + metric + admin toggle to force-forward sampled payloads for a tenant for a short TTL (RBAC + audit). Example toggle config: 
```json
{"tenant": "theta", "route": "/api/chat", "force_forward": true, "ttl_seconds": 300, "reason": "sre-dbg"}
```
zoe: good. Also add labels on metrics for redaction_state: token_only | redacted | full. That will make dashboards queryable.
frank: RFC next steps: 1) ship envelope + metrics + console panel in canary 2) admin_toggle for verification 3) consult legal about secure-forward requirements 4) if required, design edge-redact with limited KMS tokens.
ben: small perf note: envelope is tiny, should not affect router latency. Just ensure we batch envelopes to collector to avoid extra RPCs.
audit-bot: created task T-10234: add_metric:sample_envelope_forwarded, console_panel:envelope_vs_payload, admin_toggle:force_forward -> assignees [marta,ben,zoe]
marta: note for instrumentation: include sampling_policy label (static|dynamic) and consent_state. Also add envelope_hmac so legal can verify authenticity without seeing fields.
zoe: I'll open the RFC and assign eng-privacy + eng-sre + console-ux. Draft link when ready.
frank: tiny UX ask: make the amber badge link to a diagnostic view that shows recent sample_ids with timestamps (no bodies) so oncall can correlate logs quickly.
ben: agree. Also add an alert rule when envelope_forwarded > 0 but payloads_collected == 0 for >5m for a tenant. That usually means quota misconfiguration.
marta: will implement metrics and router change in a canary. Keep redact at collector for now to avoid KMS expansion.
zoe: thanks team. I'll coordinate with legal about the secure-forward ask and post the RFC here. :thumbsup:
